task: Classify detailed cancer type in esophageal cancer. Classes: esophageal squamous cell carcinoma vs. esophageal adenocarcinoma. Key H&E clues include keratinization, intercellular bridges, and nested squamous growth for squamous carcinoma versus gland formation, mucin production, and Barrett-associated columnar background for adenocarcinoma.

classes.0: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma showing squamous differentiation with keratinization, intercellular bridges, or nests of polygonal tumor cells.
classes.1: Esophageal adenocarcinoma showing malignant glands, mucin production, or infiltrative columnar-type tumor cells.
